description: Bright, clean neutral-to-warm kitchen development with controlled reflective highlights and natural cabinetry materials.

exposure.instruction: Increase overall exposure decisively enough for a bright, welcoming kitchen without clipping counters, lights, appliances, or windows.

shadows.instruction: Open shadows beneath cabinetry and counters to reveal existing detail while retaining natural depth.

highlights.instruction: Recover window, appliance, and reflective work-surface highlights while retaining a clean luminous finish.

contrast.instruction: Establish clean material separation without harsh edges, HDR compression, or sterile contrast.

whiteBalance.instruction: Neutralize casts for clean whites with slight natural warmth; no yellow cabinetry or blue-white surfaces.

vibrance.instruction: Enrich muted existing color moderately while keeping cabinetry, counters, and appliances realistic.

saturation.instruction: Use only a light controlled saturation increase.

texture.instruction: Reveal existing cabinetry and countertop texture through natural tonal separation, never invented detail.

clarity.instruction: Add restrained clarity without making appliances or edges brittle.

materialPriorities.instruction: Keep cabinetry wood warm and realistic without orange color.
Control stainless-steel and metallic reflections while retaining a clean neutral finish.

specialInstructions.instruction: Remove only a detected optical lens flare, lens glare, or veiling glare. Restore only photographic detail already established by immediately adjacent pixels; preserve every light fixture, reflection, appliance, cabinet, tile, and architectural element exactly.
